scope: static audit of the tracked legacy Gate3 shell/conductor only; no script, process, simulator, transport, Pod, GPU, or robot was run
verdict: legacy scripts are historical evidence only and are not an approved launcher for a new formal Gate3 run

risks.evidence: pkill -9 by fuzzy command pattern or global executable name is used at startup and shutdown
risks.consequence: unrelated Kit, simulator, planner, runner, ROS introspection, or another user's session can be killed without ownership proof

risks.evidence: dropout stress discovers planners using pgrep -f and SIGSTOP/SIGCONT signals every fuzzy match
risks.consequence: the conductor can suspend or resume a planner it did not launch

risks.evidence: set +e and background setsid launches do not retain PID/PGID, starttime, cmdline, or an ownership token
risks.consequence: partial launch failures continue and no later cleanup can prove process ownership

risks.evidence: there is no EXIT/INT/TERM trap around the multi-process sequence
risks.consequence: an early failure or interrupt can leave simulator, planner, ball publisher, topic echo, runner, and iceoryx processes alive

risks.evidence: GEAR, DIST, WS, and SIM_INSTALL are hard-coded to one user's home/workspace
risks.consequence: the executed source/binary/config can differ silently from the reviewed checkout

risks.evidence: vendor sim binary/config/MJCF, planner YAML, runner binary/model, and conductor are not SHA-bound before execution
risks.consequence: a Gate3 score cannot establish which plant, planner, policy, or runtime bytes actually ran

risks.evidence: ROS_DOMAIN_ID, RMW implementation, sourced overlays, and transport environment are inherited or hard-coded but not recorded/bound
risks.consequence: the run can join a foreign ROS graph or load different message/runtime libraries

risks.evidence: fixed /tmp outputs are deleted/overwritten and /dev/shm/iox1_0_* is removed by wildcard
risks.consequence: prior evidence is clobbered and unrelated shared-memory state can be destroyed

risks.evidence: readiness is inferred from loose log/topic text without recorded child identity, exit status, or content-addressed run directory
risks.consequence: stale/foreign output can satisfy a readiness check and failures lack a complete ledger

risks.evidence: the production formal --model-preflight-only loader gate is not executed before simulator/conductor runtime
risks.consequence: backend/runtime can start before the formal 179 metadata and model loader contract is proven

risks.evidence: runner is launched without --no-publish and PP_EXTRA_ARGS is an unrestricted environment-controlled flag list
risks.consequence: the legacy path is not a first-tick no-publish harness and can silently alter runtime behavior

risks.evidence: runner boot loop has no post-loop assertion and prints runner-up even when the marker never appeared
risks.consequence: the conductor can proceed after a 90-second failed boot as though the runner were ready

risks.evidence: timeout cleanup calls proc.kill on only the direct runner PID and does not validate or clean its owned process group
risks.consequence: descendants can leak, while the outer shell later compensates with unsafe broad pkill

risks.evidence: no exclusive harness/Kit/simulator/runner lock or exact existing-process conflict gate precedes cleanup/launch
risks.consequence: concurrent sessions are destroyed instead of being rejected fail-closed

plan_only_source_gate_properties: the only child commands are read-only Git helpers with GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0
no simulator, Kit, transport, planner, runner, process scan, signal, or runtime lock path exists
core artifact paths are canonical, reject every symlink ancestor, and are SHA-bound without claiming complete runtime closure
training and evaluation paths equal their clean exact-commit Git top-levels
proposed argv rejects equals-form absolute paths, unbound absolute paths, and relative payloads
the optional plan output uses fsynced temporary bytes plus atomic hard-link no-replace
the plan ledger records runtime status not_run and real robot authority false
unclosed_future_runtime_requirements: pidfd plus cgroup or reviewed supervisor startup handshake
PATH/LD/Python/AMENT manifests and complete AimRT/transitive shared-object/plugin closure
parser-backed vendor config to MJCF semantic binding
reviewed atomic runtime ledger and exact-owned runtime lock protocol
formal 179 loader and passive no-publish first tick only after all prior requirements close
vendor Gate3/Gate3B behavior remains the only promotion authority
